name: quartermaster
description: Soft-denies subagent spawns with no model set and heavy-model spawns late in the five-hour window, and shows when the window will cap at the current pace

warnAt.title: Heavy-model warning point (%)
warnAt.description: Five-hour window usage at or past which a spawn on a heavy model is soft-denied once.

heavyModels.title: Heavy models
heavyModels.description: Model names, or parts of model ids, that the heavy-model guard watches.

guardTypes.title: Guarded agent types
guardTypes.description: Agent types with no model of their own; a spawn of one that sets no model is soft-denied once.

requireModel.title: Require a model
requireModel.description: Soft-deny a spawn of a guarded agent type that sets no model.
